nodes.summary: There is a real constant $A \ge 0$ such that for every integer $n \ge 1$ and all real numbers $a_0, a_1, \dots, a_n$ with $|a_i| \ge 1$ for every $i$, the number of sign vectors $(\varepsilon_1, \dots, \varepsilon_n) \in \{-1, 1\}^n$ with $|a_0 + \varepsilon_1 a_1 + \dots + \varepsilon_n a_n| < 1$ is at most $A \cdot 2^n / \sqrt{n}$.
nodes.title: Sharp Littlewood–Offord bound

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, all complex numbers $z_1, \dots, z_n$ with $|z_i| \ge 1$ for every $i$, and every open disc $D$ of radius $1$ in $\mathbb{C}$, at most $\binom{n}{\lfloor n/2 \rfloor}$ of the $2^n$ sign vectors $(\varepsilon_1, \dots, \varepsilon_n) \in \{1, -1\}^n$ satisfy $\sum_i \varepsilon_i z_i \in D$.
nodes.title: Kleitman's theorem on signed sums in the plane

nodes.summary: The statement that for every natural number $n$, all complex numbers $z_1, \dots, z_n$ with $|z_i| \ge 1$ for every $i$, and every open disc $D$ of radius $1$ in $\mathbb{C}$, at most $\binom{n}{\lfloor n/2 \rfloor}$ of the $2^n$ sign vectors $(\varepsilon_1, \dots, \varepsilon_n) \in \{1, -1\}^n$ satisfy $\sum_i \varepsilon_i z_i \in D$ (Erdős Problem 498).
nodes.title: Strong Littlewood–Offord bound in the plane

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
